measured: semantic injects exactly 1 sourced fact (pre-change 496-char injection class); strict injects 0
injected_fact_class: a generic development-knowledge component description (search_memory_facts is a Graphiti component), admitted as the single fact
root_cause: VERIFIED. In semantic-recall.mjs selectSemanticContext: (1) a candidate is kept in the ranked pool when signal.native is true (line 23-24: recallOrigin==='graphiti' && nativeRank in [0,24)), which is independent of lexical overlap; (2) the native-rank prior (line 28: 2/(1+nativeRank*0.42)) gives the top search hit (nativeRank 0, prior 2.0) a dominant score; (3) when NO candidate has lexical overlap (anchored===false, line 109), the cap drops to 1 (line 110) and the top native-rank-prior fact is admitted. So a top native semantic hit is eligible despite zero/one lexical match and, in the unanchored single-fact case, is injected.
why_not_a_blanket_veto: The issue-75 zero-overlap paraphrase positive is relevant and is admitted via answer-type/identity/sourceContext signal, not the bare native prior. A blanket zero-lexical-overlap veto would drop it. The defect is specifically admitting a SINGLE native-only fact (cap=1, unanchored) that has no answer-type, identity, or source-excerpt support beyond the native prior.
minimal_correction_route: In selectSemanticContext, when anchored===false (cap=1), admit the single native-only fact only if it has non-trivial relevance signal beyond the native prior: answerTypeSupport(query,fact)>0 OR identitySignal(query,fact)>0 OR sourceContext lexical overlap>0. Otherwise abstain (return []). This suppresses the off-topic single-fact injection while preserving the anchored multi-fact branch (cap=maxSelected), the issue-75 zero-overlap paraphrase, and all source-exact positives (which are anchored or index-rescued).
zero_regression_requirement: zero strict-only losses (verified: strict_only_losses=[]) AND no loss of the 15/18 semantic source-exact positives AND the issue-75 zero-overlap paraphrase regression retained. The correction only affects the unanchored cap=1 single-fact path.
